items.description: It is a 2D Score based game where the player tries to stir a yacht in a river through wood logs.
This site is designed for EverQuest II players of all backgrounds to analyze, optimize, and share their characters and character builds.

EQ2U Players allows guest users to search for Characters, Guilds, Items, and Spells in EverQuest II. Users with their own accounts can keep track of their characters, as well as their Friends' and Guildmates' characters.
Flashfreeonline leverages the FlashGameDistribution so flash developers can automate customized game-broadcasts from the FlashGameDistribution server.
Play free online flash games; sports, physics, dress up, puzzle, action, arcade, multiplayer, shooting, girl, strategy games and more. Gametator.com also produces its own exclusive games.
Find wild creatures for EA Spore using this Google gadget for asset search views.
Use this interactive Flash-based app to browse EA's Spore creatures to decide how will you browse the Universe.
Watch Twitter updates in Second Life with this Twitter Fountain. Sit by the fountain of real-time tweets and watch them bubble up. This YouTube video gives you the quick demo.
This gadget grabs the Yahoo weather feed for any US zip code or international country code, and updates an object to display the current weather in Second Life.

Gridmarker.com is a free place to store, share, view, and search for your favorite locations in Second Life. You can also find new places to explore by viewing and searching favorite locations of other users.
Allows users of flickr and 23 photo services to mash up their images into an interactive web page with the option of including Google Maps or Second Life Maps as a background.

Life2Life is a real store in a virtual world. Uses the Amazon and SecondLife APIs to allow you to shop in virtual space. This link brings you to the story about it, you need Second Life to see it in action.
Slurlmarker uses your del.icio.us account to create a bookmark slurl of your favorite locations in Second Life.
Interactive USDA plant zone hardiness map.
mapits.de is a German real estate search engine based on Google Maps.
Places Near Me is a web application that takes a user's location and locates nearby services. Types of places include gas stations, restaurants, hotels, and hospitals.

Energy TACO is a Google Chrome extension which was developed during the 1st ever Cleanweb Hackathon by Matthew (@matthewfong) and Michael (@Dogtown7) from Genability (@genability). TACO stands for Total Annual Cost of Ownership. The extension allows you to seamlessly see the true cost of electronics by displaying how much you will spend each year to plug the device in. We put that cost right on the page of whatever site* you're shopping on.
Map service for finding photos, videos, news stories, wiki articles, blogs, hotels, flights, events, and anything else we can about your world.

Developers can use this this mashup to insert a Giphy search bot into their HipChat sessions. Whenever a user types /giphy plus a keyword, the Lucille HipChat Bot will return a Gif that matches the search criteria. Requirements for implementation include the Python HipChat Library.
Loku is an application that displays local neighborhood maps and lets users explore what is happening nearby. It displays news stories and videos, events and deals.

AllMusic by Rovi takes the best of AllMusic.com and packages it into a convenient app for mobile music discovery. AllMusic lets you tailor your experience, offering personalized recommendations based on music you already like.

This app is a mashup of Google Maps, an already existing Tropo application for Delaware transit locations and Phono. Since all of the Phono, Google Maps and jQuery pieces run in the client, there is no server-side logic need to make this application work. It’s all JavaScript.

Lose It! is a web and mobile application that helps users to customize a weight loss plan that fits their lifestyle. The application has many features, including but not limited to Fitness, Medical, Diet, Nutrition, and Body Measurements. The free version has limited features, while for an annual fee customers will be able to use all of the features available on Lose It!

Analyzes any Twitter account to show you the top 10 most retweeted tweets. The results are based on the past 3200 tweets by the account. Try searching for @justinbieber, @ladygaga, @CNN, anyone! Have fun!
Fertility calculator that also integrates with Google Calendar.
CommonFloor is a real estate search engine for India that populates results on Google Maps.
Real estate portal of luxury homes and condos in the San Francisco Bay Area. It shows $2.9 million+ properties and updated daily with new listings.
The Audience Finder tool lets you find Facebook users that should be part of a custom audience for your Facebook advertising campaigns.
This is a Mozilla Firefox extension for interacting with Amazon EC2. The utility lets you launch Amazon Machine Instances and then find, control, replicate and shutdown running instances.
Campus map development video by ThinkWrap.
Largest Banks in the United States with assets in thousands of dollars.
Fitness facility locator that shows gyms, athletic clubs, pilates studios, and other similar places on a Google Map.

Billigeforbrukslån.no is a Norwegian consumer portal that allows for the direct comparison between various lending and credit offers. Relevant data is collected through the public API-provider Finansportalen and the lenders' databases.

This site presents a uncluttered minimalistic interface to Amazon's International sites to enable users to search for items from all of amazon's sites in one place. Features in the pipline include: * US of GeoAPI to determine user location and hence default amazon locale. * compare prices across amazon sites allowing users to order items at the best possible price. * Enable users to receive notifications when the price of an item in their list drops or rises by a predetermined percentage/amount.
Powerfully motivating facts, tips and encouragement to help you quit smoking. Delivered to you fresh daily by voice, email and text.

RallyBound is a social fundraising platform that lets individuals from around the web to create custom campaigns for their causes. Some of the features available on RallyBound include custom campaign designs, direct donation from supporters, multiple campaign management (one site for multiple campaigns), and more.

The Udacity Android App allows users to access Udacity's programming courses from their mobile Android devices. Courses are taught by experts from companies like Facebook, Google, and Cloudera and cover programming in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Java, and other languages. The app allows users to solve programming problems and respond to short quizzes on the go.
Display your Amazon wishlist, listmania list or marketplace seller list on your website.

Ask AMEE is an experiment that makes finding things easier. Instead of giving you a list of possible methodologies that might be relevant, it gives you an answer straight away. You can put in queries like â€œ10kg of coalâ€œ, and it will go off and see if AMEE has an answer. If it does, itâ€™ll give you it straight away, and give you links to find out more if you want to.

See where your ocean container shipment is via real-time maps on SeaRates. Helps freight forwarders and logistics companies to perform global shipping operations with international container shipments.
A social, mobile, local experiment. Turn on my lamp in Brooklyn by signing up and checking-in!

Working directly with Primal's data service, the plugin automatically builds rich interest graphs around your pages, filtering news and information from across the Web. Contextual links to matching related content are displayed to your visitors, embedded alongside your post. Think of it as a personalized recommendation engine that promotes similarly themed content to your readers. This means real-time delivery of suggested content to your site's audience!

Easily add relevant photos to your blog posts without leaving Wordpress. Turn on the affiliate option to start earning money from links on your photos. Simple, automatic and lucrative photos for Wordpress blogs.

This web application called the StainedGlass Collage, first detect region of interest in your digital photo and then organize them similar to laying out a stained glass window. It also allow user to download and upload images directly to Flickr site.
OzNewsy is a mobile application that enables users to explore the history and culture of their current location while being in Australia. This mashup uses National Library of Australia Trove API.

Brings together Facebook desktop alert programs into one interface. View recent notifications, photos, an alphabetical Friend list, and receive alerts and upload photos. FizzBoost is a companion to Facebook.
Find the people making great handmade things
PelFind lets you explore interesting photos from around the web. You can also enter urls of webpages that you want to explore, create lists and more.
Export Basecamp projects to PDF. Creates reports for archiving, sharing and reading offline. Now supports images.
Service that motivates and rewards people for being active.
Linkalope uses the Twitter API to search for recently shared links on Twitter. The built in zeitgeist pulls the latest trends making it easy to search for sports, movies, tv, celebrities, and more.
Unusual use of the Google Maps API to control a non-Google map, in this case from the game World of Warcraft. It behaves just a like a Google Map using zoom, pan and drag controls.
Scan timelines of your favorite YouTube videos.
A new way of discovering music artist and albums by reading tumblr reviews about them and browsing recomendations.
SugarCRM is an online customer relationship management application, and its integration with Box.net allows SugarCRM users to view their content on Box within the SugarCRM environment.
UK site with Google Maps to help find dine-in and takeaway food. Menus and readers reviews online to peruse.
A SoundCloud user browser that displays relations and connections between users. Will also play their most popular track. It's a ActionScript 3.0 project with source code available.
Rotational velocity of a point on the surface of the Earth.
This Google Maps transit mashup takes an independent ride-guide for the San Diego Trolley and mashes it up with Google Maps.
Enter your start and end destinations and the mashup will show what tweets lie on the way.
Whenever you check in with Foursquare and you're near a transit stop, 4sqtransit will send back a text message with realtime schedule information for that location.
Tallest skyscrapers in the world measured to the architectural top.
A mashup for the ancient Roman road Via Claudia Augusta between Konigsbrunn and Epfach in Germany.
A meta search engine with images, videos and news. Enabled by social search.
Speed Dial Group Messaging allows you to quickly get in touch with your group. Make one phone call, record your message and it is sent out to your entire group by voice, email and text message.
This mashup allows you to create any kind or number of records in BatchBook directly from a Formstack form submission.
This mashup allows Box.net users to send faxes of documents stored in their Box accounts using eFax.
Island Eye has been created to achieve a focal island portal specializing in the History and Tourism of the Isle of Wight. It also helps support Island businesses and voluntary sectors.
Wrapr is a mashup between Chumakev Flash panorama player and the Flickr API. Flickr panoramic images can be wrapped into an interactive panorama. Browse for Flickr groups, and Wrapr them.
Talk to cute waifu on Desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux). Waifus are anime-themed personal assistants.
Be creative and draw a greeting for somebody you care for.
Generative fiction with Google Maps and Flickr.
Mashing up several financial tools to enable group money management among people organizing events, activities, or just needing to collect and pool money from a group of people.

STAT!Ref offers healthcare information in desktop and laptop modalities. The organization has released a mobile application that requires an online subscription. In this app, users can find content targeted to academic institutions, healthcare organizations, government, military, and public health.

An easy way to create music playlists from songs and videos available on youtube. No ads before a video starts. Save and manage playlists, share them with others and find new albums in the user-created database.
Compare LCD TV prices. The product and price data feed is pulled from the Shopping.com API.
This application allows users listen to the national anthems of countries located all around the world.
Free online rental market facts and analysis service dedicated to helping renters and investors make better rental and investment decisions.
Displays hospitals in Germany and shows their job offers.
Clockr uses random digit images from Flickr to display the current time. Click on a number to change the image, doubleclick it to view the full image. Use the mouse wheel to cycle through.
Tweets about the latest featured New York Times movie reviews.
Google map of the journey of Abass Hassans from Somalia Refugee Camps in Kenya to Princeton University.
Map of Ireland with drink prices, parking spaces and petrol prices.
iPhoneRevu is a map and list view of Yelp Reviews formated for the iPhone. iPhoneRevu is a Yelp front-end for the iPhone.
A free frequent-flyer mileage and point tracking site on the internet focused solely on tracking and managing rewards. Tools and services to make managing and redeeming miles and points easier.
A mobile phone app for finding real-time bus arrivals for Madison Metro (Madison, WI). Just text your specific request to receive real-time arrival estimates.
This Google Maps Mashup maps out Whitney Houston's journey from her birthplace (Newark, New Jersey) to Beverley Hills where she died. (click on the arrows at lower left to go into manual mode)
Provides an easy way to make your own route and share it with your friends.
Flash-based interface to Google Talk. Allows you to chat without a client install. Gtalkr also has its own API.
Digital marketplace using modified BitTorrent network for distribution. Allows sellers to list their items, and Buyers to get paid for helping distribute.
Send a Voice Message or SMS to your friends when you run out of money. Let them call you back!
Mashup of Joomla!, Amazon and Internet Video Archive.

Mix YouTube, Google Video and other video sharing services videos into one channel. Create your own TV channel. Watch pre-defined channels and the hottest ones from the aggregated sites. Video search.
Online travel blog with Flickr photo integration.
An iGoogle gadget that shows the most recent 100 trends, along with a short description of why they are currently trending.

A Mashup of global golf course data. Thousands of markers displayed on Google Maps. Integrated with the Google Earth Web Plugin and Golf Course date from GolfFrontier.com. Many courses have a 3D course tour.
Free real estate search site using Google Maps, Streetview and Bing's Bird's eye view. Shows properties in Argentina, Spain and Uruguay.
A user powered, map driven directory of free and inexpensive camping locations in the USA and Canada. The website includes descriptions, maps, photos and reviews.
Earthquake map mashup that uses Google Maps. Turkey earthquakes updated daily.
Geomium is a local social application that allows you to meet people near you and see what's going on around you. Geomium. Live local. Live social.
Snaplickr is a Flickr photos search tool and social utility. Users can bookmark favorite photos and leave comments for others. Rich Flash based UI.

Ez School Bus Locator is the only location app (mashup) available in the market that: Is custom made for schools/parents Helps parents locate the bus as well their wardâ€™s availability in the school bus Supports both non-Internet phones along with smart phones to get the location details. This app comprises two modules - Ez School Bus Locator (Parent) and Ez School Bus Locator (Attender). Both these modules work together (in Client/Server mode).
Demo service from Pho.to for creating animated gif avatars or static avatars for free. You can adopt the same functionality on your site using the pho.to API.
Local classified ads for jobs, housing, personals, services, items for sale and more.

Dino Map provides users with a visual and interactive way to explore all of the fossil records in the Paleobiology Database, which includes plants, insects, mammals, reptiles, dinosaurs, and more. This mashup was built using the Google Maps API.

This website gives you an easy interface to the App.net API. First you sign-up using your AppNet account. After sign-up you can use the console to try API queries and see the result in both JSON and rendered views.
Map of Edmonton, Alberta, attractions.
www.jobsdbcenter.com is a jobs listing mashup site using indeed and google map API . we use also payscale for salary research.
Graphical analysis of job posts on Craigslist.org across all of US.
TweetaCelebe lists all the verified celebrities and personalities on Twitter and allows users to track their tweet streams and follow them.
Soccer video mashup covering both video games, like Fifa 08, and real soccer including world cups, popular players, etc.
Test your knowledge of where countries are located with this interactive map quiz.

The PLD Mashup offers graphics and design solutions spanning across various domains that include logo and website designs as well as mobile applications and e-commerce platforms. The mashup’s provider works closely with developers to support unlimited revisions and achievement of best results.
Mitsubishi dealer locator for the UK.
Aggregating news into categorized topics from online sources. Features include news cloud, rate news, news discussion, and more. Find local news, world news, and forums.
Map based data visualization tool driven by Pentaho open source business intelligence tools and Google Maps.
Japanese mashup combining videos and Google Maps.

Worldsaurus.com is a worldwide travel guide to help adventurous budget-travelers, backpackers, photographers, and vacationers plan their trips. Find the most popular places in the world, with detailed information.
Map Tunneller allows users to view the direct antipode of a given location. Users can zoom and pan around on the top map and view the selected location's antipode on the bottom map.
Tour of California Cycling Blog covers 100+ mile bike rides. GPS satellite data, route profiles, pictures, and more information is available.
MP3 Search Engine
New York state's Contemporary Canal System educator's guide with an interactive area map. Also has directions. Was created for WCNY.

Last Call is a free, easy way to estimate your blood-alcohol level and determine if it's safe for you to drive after drinking. If not, use it to call a cab. Last Call also provides a list of top local DUI lawyers, provided by Avvo, to call for help if you need it.
Find the best airports for wifi. Based on a Forbes survey of the most wired airports, mapped on Google Maps.
A picturesque look at the world’s best motorcycle roads.
Last-minute vacation rental listings. All properties available in the next two weeks. Browse listings on a Google Map.
Take a video tour around London and add your own content to this graphically rich travel video mashup.
Google Mapping ACT Scores by state in math, reading, science, and English categories.
Use this interactive map to find Boots Optician stores in the UK.
Service for locationbudget hotels and motels in North America. 30,000 properties listed. Budget Bellhop searches discount hotel sites to locate hotel discounts and cheap rates.

fitsquare sends users real-time messages in order to encourage them to check in to healthy venues on foursquare. They can also earn exclusive badges, compete against friends and track progress. Plus it's completely free to participate!
Browse Amazon Catalog for Movies, Books, Music, Electronic gadgets and more! By using affiliate account, you can get paid too!
The Apprentice on NBC starts a new season this week. This maps shows the hometown of each contestant on Google Maps with their current status of either Active or Fired.
Twippr is a safe, simple way to send and receive money online, using direct private messages from your Twitter account. Accept Twippr micropayments to save Paypal fees.
GetControl is a mobile payment application that provides businesses a way to measure and manage their online payments. This application is built for mobile, and uses Stripe API.

A unified social tool that simplifies social login and single sign-on implementation. With the tool, you can allow users to log into your website using Facebook, Twitter, Google, Amazon, LinkedIn, and 25 more ID providers. You can also get accurate social profile data and social analytics.
A Google Gadget to notify you of the count of unread items in your Bloglines account.

The SEO Audit tool from SEO Review Tools, utilizes the power of Ahrefs, SEMrush and MOZ to present you with a full website SEO audit in just 15 seconds. Data returned by this tool include: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Search volume and Backlink count. After entering your URL, this tool will analyse your website based on 21 different data points.
rOpenSci offers packages that provide programmatic access to a warehouse of data repositories, with a focus on scholarly works. rOpenSci uses the Mendeley API as a source for scholarly articles.
Share your location in real-time using Mologogo. A free service that will track your friends GPS-enabled cell phones from another phone or on the web. With various social networking features.
PhoneTacToe uses the Twilio, Twilio SMS and Heroku APIs and allows you to play a quick game of tic-tac-toe with a friend on your phone.
Fun flickr mashup that lets you add cartoon bubbles to photos.

Use the site to create a voodoo character and subject it to all kinds of fun. It is customizable, so you can make the character look like yourself. Then get the Voodoo Character on a t-shirt to share with friends.
BART station maps, schedules, timetables, and other details in a convenient Google Map
Site developed to help dirt bike riders find places and people to enjoy their sport.
This map displays the amount of restaurants by category and neighborhood. Using the Google Maps API, the data is displayed on a map that can easily be navigated by users.
Display Google Street View and Twitter messages nearby. Submit your own area for driving. Parameters are lat and lng.
Uses Google maps API to show affordable accommodation locations worldwide.
SportCentral is a web application that enables users to connect with one another for recreational sports purposes. It utilizes APIs such as Google AdSense, Google AdWords,..
CrocTail provides an interface for browsing information parsed from SEC filings about several hundred thousand U.S. publicly traded corporations and their foreign subsidiaries.
An interesting way to look at real estate in the UK.

Halter Top for Women. A fully SEO website that pulls in data from Shopzilla using their API. Can be used for UK and US. Each category page is editable and all pages have Meta titles. Easy to navigate and setup. Managed via admin panel.
Low cost airline routes mapped. Uses Google's Maps and AJAX Libraries and shows direct flights for most LCC in the world.
Smartinsurance.sg is a new car insurance comparison site that makes it extremely easy for you to compare singapore car insurance prices online.
Free tool to measure the power and authority of a Twitter user.
Provides tracking information of DHL packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.

Psykotube is a great way to browse lots of videos really quickly. With Really simple and neat interface. This is great to get an overall vibe of a search and is at times faster than youtube's own search tool!

S3 file share sharing work off the amazon s3 web service platform, allows you to share large files upload pictures share with family friends work colleges give users bucket access, backup websites filter images and lots more.
Music Portal a.k.a indotag.com is a portal of music blog posts and provides a concise snapshot of the latest in music blogging.
View tracks on a map. See music uploaded to SoundCloud spread over the globe. Discover new music and find out what people are doing on the other side of the world.
Create, update, and track your business plan with your entire team and export out a document version at any time.
Find areas to hike and explore in NE Indiana. ACRES has been dedicated to acquiring and preserving natural areas since 1960.
Washington DC city and transit guide Google Maps mashup. Metro Links also combines blog postings from Window Shopper, Free Ride and Top Stops.
Map-based price and fuel quality reporting community covering Brazil. Try searching for Rio de Janeiro
Free World Wide Listing of Adoptable Dachshunds
See if it will freeze in your area tonight. Uses HTML5 and is geolocation-enabled to quickly check weather conditions on mobile and desktop browsers.
Online shopping based on Amazon eCommerce. Written as a hybrid of PHP and Perl. Stores data in flat files. More then 60,000 products in over 60 categories.

Breadcrumbs is a free cutting edge online GPS track management software allowing you to upload GPS tracks with photos and videos for all of your adventures. You will be able to share them with your friends and connect to people who have the same interest as you. Breadcrumbs revolves around Google Earth, which is embedded in your browser.
Users can Dub any YouTube video with the sound of the other video, classify them as funny, sad, action etc. View user videos and then share their creations with friends. More uses onsite.
This is a mashup showing the capitals of the fify states of the United States and the respective state nicknames

Amanda Enterprise is a certified, tested, and supported version of the popular Amanda open source backup and recovery tool. Amanda can now use Amazon S3 to backup, archive and retrieve any amount of data, at any time, from anywhere on the Internet.

TapTravel is a mobile application that allows users to search for and book for flights. TapTravel is available in all major mobile platforms. The Allmyles API has been integrated into this application.
Compares over 65,000 hotels, apartments, bed and breakfasts and guest houses across Europe. Now your site can too with this hotel search widget. Widget also uses the sletoh.com hotel comparison API.
Choose a London Underground station to see nearby hotels.
Search for an artist and view videos, photos, and a discography for the artist.

Touristica is a Turkish tourism agency been serving the travel services industry since 1994. Providing quality service to customers is of utmost importance, and Touristica wants to create importance and value in tourism opportunities for guests and partners.

Free online mapping tool to see and share your data on GoogleMaps. Just choose a country and a way to create your map by color, type values or by uploading your excel files (you can even use your zip/postal code column to get the best and most accurate maps). Publish and share maps.
A Google Maps and Hellenic National Tourist Organization mashup with information about mountain refuges in Greece. With links to tourist site details.

Text2residents.com is a simple and effective way for multifamily and senior living management to communicate instantly with residents, their families and staff members via text messages to their mobile phones and devices.
The world is your social oyster. Create your social network on a Google map. Invite your friends and see how you know people all over the world.
Shop for a variety of gifts. Uses the Amazon eCommerce API.
Tweekly.fm is a mashup between last.fm and twitter. It sends a weekly tweet listing your top weekly artists with their playcounts.
Spookiest places around the world as identified by Forbes.
An Australian Real Estate Search engine. Found results are displayed in Google Earth and on the Google Map.

QuickMocker is an online API tool that allows to create your own public domain and a fake web services, intercept and debug requests in live mode, use regular expressions as URL paths and multiple HTTP methods per endpoints, prioritize endpoints. With QuickMocker you can easily integrate 3rd party reverse requests (webhooks) using Local Forwarder feature that can forward request even to your localhost URL.

Hashtag Suggestions allows users to find hashtags to use for each topic. A user enters the topic in the search box, and the tool will provide a list of hashtags used with that topic. The size of hashtag indicates it's popularity.
A novel system that can automatically read reviews and generate an accurate summary.
UKBirdMap is a Google Map of bird sightings reported via Twitter. Tweets with the hashtag #ukbirdcount, a UK postcode and the species of bird spotted are automatically added to the map in real-time.
Keep to your kosher diet with this handy Google Maps mashup.
FoxyMap is a Google Gadget which allows you to monitor the locations of speed traps. Those locations are set via mobile tagging by the users of the mobile application FoxyTag.
Collection site where users can post things they collect, have, or want to trade. Uses RapLeaf as a feedback and reputation system.

Let's search tweets on TweetingEarth.com. You can check tweets around the world from each timezone. You can rotate Earth using Mouse wheel, and also show up tweets window by clicking timezone. This site is using HTML5 features (such as SVG) so this site does not work on old version of IE. However we support modern browsers such as Safari, Firefox, Chrome, Opera, IE9 and also iPad.

This mashup is a simple web app demo that demonstrates how a real time chat application using the Beebotte API would behave. Users are able to create a tag ID, login, enter text, and post to a message board. Beebotte supports REST, Websockets and MQTT protocols to connect IOT devices in real time.
Uses Yahoo! Query Language, the Twitter API, and HTML5 Canvas to generate interesting art from tiny Twitter avatars.from

Our powerful, easy-to-use background check search tools and technology enable fast access to comprehensive background check data with a range of search solutions that meet your varying needs. The ProntoScreen instant background check searched our proprietary criminal records database as well as other public sources like court records, incarceration records, prison records, probation & parole release information & more!

A cool Google Maps and Tour de France mash-up: Displays drivers data live on a interactive map. And you can can even follow the bike position. Heart beat, speed, stress points, distance, power and current position are tracked.
If you need a pint in Folkestone UK this Google Map can help you find the right pub.
Map of March 2008 protests in Tibet, and ensuing events. With photos, summaries, and links to supporting documentation about the Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy, TCHRD, website.

Bitcoin Checkout is an open source Google App Engine demo project that shows a checkout and invoicing system that works for Bitcoin, Litecoin, or Blackcoin. It provides QR and BIP32-compliant payment links and includes real-time sensing of completed payments. This mashup was built using the Coinkite API and demonstrates the Coinkite Python Library.

WikiWalki lets you search, draw, and share your favorite outdoor trail by importing and exporting GPS data and Google mapping them. Use it to email a cool map of your walk, bike ride or running trail to your friends or find a new hike or city tour nearby.

Maplight.org combines political results with financial contributions to show how capital contributions affect voting. This specific mashup allows users to track financial contributions that might have swayed votes for different bills.
Find maps of wineries found within each wine region.

This widget will display the latest items from the Digg website. You can change its preferences to point to change the minimum number of diggs and count of displayed items. More than just RSS, it displays both the item content and images.
Give away the junk that is cluttering up your life or find stuff you really need for free.

Healthy Lemur is an app that lets you publicly commit to exercise: - Link your foursquare account - Select the number of days per week that you're going to exercise - Link your facebook and/or twitter accounts And you're all set! We will track every time you go to the gym and every Monday, we will post on facebook and/or twitter account if you have reached your goal (or we will shame you publicly if you haven't!)

Coopcities uses mainly the Foursquare API to provide improved interface, specially to desktop users. It offers more than Foursquare default 30 results with pagination, one click access to all available categories, breadcrumb navigation (increased privacy, and other features.
Workouts is a flex based application that uses the del.icio.us API to find workouts related to user selected muscle groups.
Real-time photos from Twitter on top of Google Maps.
